reviewer_activity.canonical_input_read_scope: Post-completion read-only verification: full input hashes, all 252000 original observation/CSV record pairs, and saved query/truth endpoint. No checkpoint or model execution.
reviewer_activity.truth_read_stage: after attempt002 completed; descriptive reporting only

findings: The amended contract correctly matches unchanged CLI start semantics: free public starts 0,1,2; constrained start0 is the free theta and subsequent starts are public 0,1. No solver edit or extra invocation is needed.
The fixed Q theta index is 6 for this seven-coordinate replay theta. The current-SOC link is entering z0 = target + signed charge/Q, not the latest recursive current state as an initial state.

The objective contains the selected voltage likelihood once. Repeated optimizer evaluations reevaluate that objective; the recursive posterior and prequential score are not added as independent evidence.

The control compares bounded likelihood optima/local geometry with an approximate recursive posterior point, which are different inferential objects. It cannot uniquely attribute a discrepancy to one historical approximation.

A feasible constrained result is a witness. Its high objective cannot globally exclude the target; a constrained result below the free result makes the free baseline incomplete and cannot trigger a retry.
Finite nonconverged output may complete the predeclared constrained calls but cannot be promoted to an exclusion, validated interval or global optimum.
The three-call, prefix, iteration, CPU/wall/RSS/output limits are finite. Original data, source, learner and scorer remain immutable.
implementation_review_requirements: Bind the exact witness JSONL to the frozen base and select only the unique aggregate n=252000 capacity_Ah/current_soc fields; do not consult truth/error fields.
Verify all 252000 CSV rows bit-for-bit against the original binary records, original index order and actual dt/current/voltage; hash the source and derived representations.
Preserve exact-child resource accounting, total supervisor wall/RSS limits, exclusive failure receipts, strict JSON, bounded output and no automatic retry.

Calculate unrestricted local target SD only from the free fit undamped Gram and its full coordinate scales. Endpoint SOC gradient in replay theta is dz/dz0=1 and dz/dlogQ=charge/Q. The linked constrained-SOC matrix is a changed chart and must not be treated as unrestricted target uncertainty.

Do not inherit the legacy assessment eigenvalue cutoff as a new acceptance gate. Report raw legacy output honestly, but any independently derived precision must avoid clipping/pseudoinverse thresholds and expose numerical conditioning or failure.
Source and executable identities must be frozen before the first optimizer invocation. Compilation and --help do not qualify optimizer results.

original_query_verification.verification: Reviewer independently streamed the full original query member and recomputed SHA256, Git-blob SHA1, byte count, row count and unique target-line identity; selected only aggregate point/availability fields.

canonical_result_review.objective_definition: objective_full is the explicit full-history half sum of squared voltage residuals divided by sigma_V squared, without the fixed Gaussian additive constant. Signed deltas use objective_full. objective is separately retained and agrees up to summation roundoff.

local_precision_review.scope: Independent algebra on retained free Gram only; no model/solver/reference execution; exact binary64 entries embedded in Decimal at 70-digit precision
local_precision_review.gradient_formula: endpoint SOC = z0-charge_Ah/exp(logQ); g_scaled = coordinate_scales * g_raw; Gram already uses sigma-whitened residual Jacobians
local_precision_review.interpretation: Local unrestricted Gauss-Newton precision in this interior free fit, not calibrated posterior/frequentist coverage or global identifiability; no constrained-chart covariance and no eigenvalue clipping/pseudoinverse.

free_errors.semantics: Descriptive single-endpoint errors divided by local curvature SDs; not calibrated tail probabilities or coverage.

result_interpretation: Both predeclared constrained fits have higher returned full objective than the free fit. Neither beats the free baseline; no additional fit is authorized or needed to complete this control.

The free fit supplies a retained nonlinear-history likelihood witness at a different SOC/Q location. The available local optimizer results do not establish global optimum, global target exclusion or unique historical causation.

The free Q local SD is approximately the same scale as the original recursive delta-method Q SD. The large Q disagreement at this checkpoint is predominantly a location discrepancy; these results do not justify blanket covariance inflation as a remedy.
Both original recursive local intervals contain their own declared points and miss the held-out truth at this endpoint. Their numerical self-containment does not establish calibrated coverage.

The bounded likelihood fit and prior-conditioned recursive mixture are different inferential objects; neither objective nor curvature may be added to a posterior already conditioned on the same observations.

The full matrix was formed before damping and Schur reduction, but it is a Gauss-Newton likelihood Jacobian Gram. It omits residual second derivatives and is local; its inverse is not automatically a posterior covariance.
All retained fits report zero active linear constraints and outer bounds. No unrestricted precision is inferred from either constrained fit, particularly the linked endpoint-SOC chart.

The observed host memory and timing establish only this bounded desktop control. They do not qualify complete Cortex-M23 memory, compute, streaming evidence retention or indefinite numerical behavior.

The original aggregate and each of the two component local Q and SOC intervals miss endpoint truth; both free local two-SD display bands contain it. These six exclusions and two inclusions are a single-checkpoint descriptive comparison, not an interval calibration study.

reporting_review.source_review: Full static reducer review: closed inference and all hashes precede truth; exact free chart and scale gradients, no extra sigma, damping, eigenvalue clipping or pseudo-inverse; identities and all new numeric reductions reconciled. No material blocker.
reporting_review.limitation: Independent arithmetic checks use retained fit matrices and objectives. They do not reevaluate model trajectories, derivatives or residual likelihoods, and do not establish calibration or global fits.
